key: nvidia|senior product manager run ai dsx os
title: Senior Product Manager - Run:ai DSX OS
jd_excerpt:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 This is an opportunity to build the future of open AI infrastructure. NVIDIA is looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the strategy and go-to-market for Run:ai and related DSX OS components. As part of our team, you will define how our open-source GPU orchestration platform evolves and grows within the NVIDIA ecosystem and beyond. You will collaborate closely with NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs), Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), and the open-source community to ensure successful adoption and integration of our products.
 What you’ll be doing: 
 Define the product strategy for Run:ai and associated DSX OS components. Decide their areas of success, compatibility with the NVIDIA stack, and key goals for each release benefiting NVIDIA and its partners.
 Build and run the public roadmap, decide what ships, in what order, and which adoption metrics prove it is working.
 Treat NCPs and ISVs as build partners, turning their needs into requirements, integrations, and joint launches.
 Connect with the community on GitHub: sort through issues and suggestions, collect input, and incorporate it into the roadmap.
 Drive building, priority, and trade-off decisions with engineering teams across the platform.
 Lead go-to-market with Product Marketing and field teams, from positioning and launch plans to partner enablement.
What We Need to See: 
 BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
 8+ years in the technology industry, including 5+ years of product management for infrastructure or platform products.
 Demonstrated experience managing product development for an open-source project and collaborating with its community on GitHub.
 Responsibility for strategy and market introduction of a technical product: positioning, launches, and partner enablement.
 Hands-on work with cloud providers or ISVs, such as integrations, partner programs, or co-selling.
 Technical depth in Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure, plus a solid grasp of AI training and inference workloads.
 Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication for audiences from developers to executives.
 Ways to Stand Out from the crowd: 
 Background at, or alongside, a GPU cloud provider.
 A partner or ISV program built from the ground up, or a seat in open-source governance such as a CNCF working group.
 Leadership agreement for a product strategy you wrote, or a launch you ran end to end, from positioning to field enablement.
 NVIDIA is dedicated to encouraging a diverse workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We greatly value diversity among our current and future employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
 We are an equal opportunity employer and appreciate diversity at our company. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please inform us and we will collaborate with you to address your needs. Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/
